description.text: Why choose to study this program? This program is offered by School of Aeronautics Science and Engineering of Beihang University, which cultivated many professional in aeronautics field and achieved many scientific research. Flight Vehicle Design and Engineering ranks No. 1 among the whole country. Main Courses Descriptive Geometry, Engineering Materials, Mechanical Drawing, Mechanics of Materials, Theoretical Mechanics, Fundamental Physics, Manufacturing Technology etc. Main practical teaching links: computer experiment courses, computer training, course design and production practice and graduation design, the general practice teaching of not less than 30 weeks. Major experiments: complete at least one of the professional direction of a group of professional laboratory, etc Internship and Career Development Through 4 years study, graduates can master and basic knowledge of math, mechanics, know basic theory of aircraft engineering and general structure design and strength analysis of aircraft. Graduates of this major could work on aircraft general design, structure design and research, structure strength analysis and test, and become advanced professional engineering technicians and research person on general mechanical design and manufacturing. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Engineering Accommodation Shared bed-room with a bathroom: 650 RMB/Mth.per bed* Single room with bathroom: 1,300 RMB/Mth. per room* * Electric and water costs are not included.

duration.text: The Flight Vehicle Design and Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. HSK

requirements.text: 1.Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA 2.Applicants should have the equivalent of a high school education 3.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school 4.Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general 5.Applicants should have good command of English and the ability to take courses in English; Applicants are required to submit the certificates of 90 or more in TOEFL, 5.5 or more in IELTS or any other proofs about English level. All the applicants should pass the English Level Test at the beginning of the first semester in BUAA
